Description: Job Title: Marketing Account Manager, New Product Development Organizational Unit: Customer Growth & Engagement Division: Corporate & Customer Service Location: Moose Jaw Salary: $5,855 to $7,611 per month (Management Level 4) Short Description As the Marketing Account Manager ,New Product Development, you will evaluate the potential to expand products and services currently utilized by SaskWater including; AMI and the intelligence gathered through data collected, leak detection, air and water drone services, metering and billing. You will undertake research to understand market opportunities and challenges, industry best practices, new technologies and existing operating practices to formulate new products and services. You will use data and trends to help quantify and qualify new opportunities. You will collaborate with Customer Growth and Engagement, Finance, Engineering and Operations to ensure products contribute to company operations and achieve corporate goals. Working in a multi-functional team environment, you will develop business cases and implement marketing plans and strategies to position new products and services to grow new market segments. You will have a clear understanding of the industry and its challenges. Job Duties Undertake market research and analysis and monitor industry and technology trends for the purpose of identifying, evaluating and developing new lines of business and services and enhancing existing lines of business. Utilize the knowledge gained to determine areas where a new product may provide a competitive advantage or disrupt a market to provide a return on investment for SaskWater. Analyze market research trends and post commercialization sales data to ensure that products and services are viable and competitive. Adjust market pricing and product positioning as required to improve product sales. Continuously monitor and research customer trends to understand customer needs and expectations, using valuable input from customer satisfaction and feedback surveys. Evaluate SaskWater’s current products and services and compare them against those currently being offered in the industry. Establish, implement and administer the new product development framework and related processes for SaskWater. Work collaboratively with the innovation committee to identify and evaluate potential new products and services from the ideas submitted by SaskWater employees. Identify opportunities to expand the water and wastewater services and technologies SaskWater currently uses for its own benefit, or to enhance the value of the services provided to existing customers, positioning SaskWater as a full service provider. These include, but are not limited to; AMI, WAVE analytics, wood lot/irrigated effluent, leak detection, asset management, drone information gathering, collection metering and billing. Prioritize potential new products and services according to market potential, contribution margin and marketability. Develop business cases and obtain approval to implement new product lines, services and/or enhancements to existing lines of business. Develop pilot projects to substantiate new product concepts, evaluate the results and make recommendations for commercialization. Develop marketing and pricing strategies to effectively commercialize and grow the new product line, service or enhanced line of business. Support the account managers in the implementation and sale of new products by educating and coaching them to ensure the marketing and sales strategies are successful. Attend various industry trade shows to increase awareness and further enhance and develop knowledge of the industry and opportunities. Qualifications To qualify, you will have a degree in Commerce or Administration, specializing in Marketing or similar discipline. A valid Class 5 driver’s license is required.
